senses.gloss: (also चकोराक्ष)--a son and commander of भण्ड. Br. IV. २१. ८०; २६. ४७.
--(स्वातिकर्ण) Andhra king ruled for 6 months; son of Sunandana. His son was Bahava? M. २७३. ११. भा. XII. 1. २६.
(I)--a son of सत्यभामा and कृष्ण. M. ४७. १७.
(III)--Mt. a hill of कुशद्वीप. भा. V. २०. १५.
(IV)--a तीर्थ visited by बलराम. भा. X. ७८. १९.
(V)--a Mt. that entered the sea from fear of Indra--also Cakravat. Br. II. १८. ७८; M. १२१. ७२.
(VI)--the wheel of नक्षत्रस्, and planets. वा. ५०. ९३; ५८. २३; Vi. IV. १३. ८५ and ९८.
--a R. of the Bhadra continent. वा. ४३. २५.
--a Marut of the first गण. Br. III. 5. ९१.
--took part in the देवासुर war between Bali and Indra. भा. VIII. १०. २१.
--R. near Pulaha's hermitage. भा. V. VII. १०.
--a name of ललिता. Br. IV. १८. १५.
--declared the law re. एकोद्दिष्ट; was asked to give up sleep for the churning of the ocean. M. १८. 1; २०. ३८; २४९. १४.
--one of the seven रत्नस् of a king. वा. ५७. ६८.
--symbols of cakra and matsya on the feet of a cakravartin. वा. ५७. ७९.
--see चक्रराजरथेन्द्र. Br. IV. १९. २८.

--श्रीचक्र? Nine sections are dis- tinguished. In the ninth पर्व (section) are ten presiding deities--the siddhi devis. In a part of this पर्व were stationed the eight शक्तिस्. Above them were the ten मुदा- devis or प्रकटशक्तिस्. In the eighth पर्व there were six- teen शक्तिस् named Guptas. In the seventh पर्व were six गुप्ततरास् with sugarcane bow, flower dart and flower balls. In the sixth पर्व were the twelve आज्ञाशक्तिस्. In the fifth were ten कुलोत्तीर्ण s4aktis. In the fourth were ten Nigar- [page१-572+ ३६] bhayogini शक्तिस्. In the third were the eight Rahasya- yogini शक्तिस्. In the second were her favourites three in number. Where this was, there was Geyaratha and where the latter was, there was किरिचक्र। These three looked like the three worlds or like the three mountains namely the Meru, Mandara and the Vindhyas. ललिता was चक्रराज. There were six charioteers. Ten yojanas in length, covered by an umbrella of that height as indication of ललिता's साम्- राज्यम्. In the other two, rather ordinary umbrellas were seen. विषङ्ग came from rear in disguise, protected by कामेश्वरी, the Nityas, अणिमस् and other deities in its ninth पर्व। कुतिलाक्ष attacked in front. The Nityas kill- ed all the १५ commanders of विषङ्ग who fled for life. This was directed towards the Mahendra hill, itself in the middle; on its left and right sides the chariots of दण्डिणि and श्यामल, rear Sarupadevi and front हयासन: at the gate were stationed २० aks2auhin2is with Stambhini alias Vighnadevi; one hundred अक्षौहिणिस् to guard the chariot; all the nine पर्व deities shook with fear seeing the great army following भण्ड; on its front was गेयचक्र and behind was किरिचक्र; there were other शक्तिस् riding on different animals--lion, camel, deer, elephant, etc. at the entrance was ज्वालामालिनिक; the fight began on the fourth day and ended in complete success; in the neighbour- hood of चिन्तामणिग्रह. Br. IV. १९. (whole); २५. ५४ to १०४; २६. 4 and ३७; २८. १७; २९. ३५. १४५; ३१. 3; ३६. 7.

--came into being in Treta and partook the अम्श of Hari to protect Dharma. Their seven रत्नस्-- cakra, ratha, मणि, sword, carma, Ketu, and nidhi (some include wife, horse and elephant and leave out sword and Ketu) and seven creatures: wife, purohita, सेनानि, rathakrit, mantri, अश्व and kalabha; had the attributes of विष्णु; they enjoyed trivarga, fame and success, ऐश्वर्य like अणिम and Prabhu शक्ति; learned and pure; entertained with their prowess sages, gods, devils, men, etc.; bodily characte- [page१-573+ २९] ristics of; legs with the symbol of wheel and fish, hands with conch and lotus.
1: Br. I. 1. ९८; II. २९. ७१ ff.; M. १४२. ६४-75; वा. ५७. ६६-80.
Reigned for a long time with दण्डनीति.
2: Br. III. 7. २७५.
वालि was a चक्रवर्ती. Arjuna (कार्तवीर्य) was another.
3: Ib. ६९. २३.
--a name of ललिता. Br. IV. १८. १६.
--an Angirasa and मन्त्रकृत्. Br. II. ३२. ११०.
--a son of Bala (Bali-वा। प्।) who was कर्ण in his previous birth. Br. III. 6. ३३; वा. ६८. ३२.

--birds noted for their staunch love;
1: Br. II. १५. ७९; III. 7. ४५८; ५०. ४१; वा. ४५. १९; ५४. ३१.
the seven sons of कौशिक took their form in मानस; on the ऐरावदि.
2: M. २०. १७; २१. 9 and २८; ११३. ७६; ११६. ११.
--a तीर्थम् sacred to पितृस्. M. २२. ४२.
--killed by कृष्ण. भा. X. ४३. २५.
--the sixth गान्धार gra1ma (music). वा. ८६. ४२.
--a goddess from the back of नृसिम्ह; a follower of वागीशी. M. १७९. ६८. [page१-574+ २३]
(I)--an आर्षेय pravara of अन्गीरस्. M. १९६. २३.
(II)--a name of कृष्ण. Vi. IV. १३. ८५.
--a name of ललिता. Br. IV. १७. १९; १८. १५.
(I)--a son of व्युष्ट and पुष्करिणी; wife आकूति (वीरिणि-म्। प्।) and son Manu. भा. IV. १३. १५; VIII. 5. 7; M. 4. ४०.
(II)--a son of Anu. भा. IX. २३. 1; Vi. IV. १८. 1.
(IV)--a son of शिष्ट. M. 4. ३९. [page१-575+ २८]
(V)--a Marut गण. M. १७१. ५२.
(VI)--a R. from the हिमालयस्. Br. II. १६. २७; १८. २२.

(VII)--a branch of the गन्गा, descending Mala- यवती and traversing the continent of केतुमाल, enters the western sea; flows through the countries of चीनमरु, ताला, मसमूलिक, Bhadra, तुषारस्, लाम्यक, बाह्लव, पारट and खश. भा. V. १७. 5 and 7; Br. II. १८. ४१, ४६-7; M. १२१. ४०; वा. ४७. ३९, ४४; Vi. II. 2. ३४, ३७; 8. ११३.
(I)--a son of Ripu and बृहति; his son was the great Manu born to his wife वारुणी. Br. II. ३६. १०२.

(II)--a son of Bali's slave girl through दीर्- ghatamas;
1: Br. III. ७४. ७१; वा. ९९. ७०.
attained Brahmanhood with his brother कक्षि- vat.
2: वा. ९९. ९४.
(III)--a son of Khanitra, and father of वीम्श. V. IV. 1. २५.

(I)--the sixth Manu (s.v.) and son of Cak- षुष. पूरू and others were his sons. In his epoch Mantra- druma (Manojava-वि। प्।) was Indra. हविष्मत् and others were sages. Hari manifested himself as Ajita.
1: भा. VIII. 5. 7-9; Br. I. 1. १०५; वा. ३०. ३७; ६२. 3; १०१. ३३.
There was a deluge in this Manvantara.
2: भा. I. 3. १५; IV. ३०. ४९; VI. 6. १५; Vi. III. 1. 6, २६-9.
After him came Vaivasvata.
3: Br. II. ३६. 3. ६६, १०७, २०२; ३७. १९ and ४६; III. 2. 1; ६०. 1; IV. 1. २६ and ५०.
(II)--the son of Khanitra, and father of वीविम्शति. भा. IX. 2. २४.
(III)--a son of Anu. M. ४८. १०.
(IV)--a son of विश्वेश. M. १७१. ४८.
(V)--the king of चाक्षुषे antara, son of Prace- tasa and grandson of प्राचीनबर्हिस्; he will give birth to दक्ष from मार्षा, the daughter of शाखिन्स्. वा. ३०. ६०-61, ७४-5.
(VI)--the son of बृहति and Ripu; wife वारुनि (पुष्करिनि) and father of चाक्षुष Manu. वा. ६२. ८८-9; १००. २६; Vi. I. १३. 2. 3. [page१-594+ ३१]
--a consort of मार्ताण्ड Bhairava. Br. IV. ३५. ४७; ३६. १५.

--one of the five देवगणस् of the epoch of the १४थ् Manu (Bhautya);
1: भा. VIII. १३. ३४; Br. IV. 1. १०६-7; वा. १११. १००; Vi. III. 2. ४३.
seven among them are distin- guished.
2: वा. १००. ११२.

--(the sixth): five देवगणस्, the first, past, future, पृथुकस्, and lekhas; each गण sub- divided into eight.
1: वा. ६२. ५७.
दक्ष became son of Pracetas by the curse of शिव.
2: Br. II. १३. ६८.
